{{Quote|His physiology is supposed to be delicate or something, like a canary's.|Lando Calrissian, discussing Quor'sav passenger [[Waywa Fybot]]|<ref name="Oseon" />}}
A '''canary''' was a creature known for its delicate physiology. The avian [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had a similarly frail constitution, which led the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to compare their physiology to a canary<ref name="Oseon" /> sometime between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', which includes the mention of the canary, between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The canary was mentioned in the [[1983]] novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', the second entry in [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] trilogy of novels by [[L. Neil Smith]].<ref name="Oseon" />
